title: Dong Zhuo's Tyranny
content_zh:
In the capital Luoyang, the warlord Dong Zhuo seized power. He deposed the young emperor, installed a puppet, and burned the imperial library. His soldiers raped and pillaged without restraint.
Cao Cao, a cunning advisor, attempted to assassinate Dong Zhuo with a bejeweled dagger. When he failed, he fled to his home province and raised an army, calling lords from across the land to unite against the tyrant.
The coalition of eighteen lords formed. Liu Bei, though barely a knight, came with his two brothers. No one took him seriously — until Guan Yu slew the fearsome warrior Hua Xiong with a single stroke of his Green Dragon Crescent Blade, which weighed eighty-two jin.
